changes.title: Clear burst
items: Clearing an area before its wave now sets off a little burst of sparks and rising motes at its new soundsystem, in the area's colour

changes.title: Claw slashes
items: Her health is now glowing red claw slashes across her: one per hit, three and she's down; the newest fades away along its length as she heals

changes.title: Wave dropdown
items: How often the waves come is now a dropdown in the top right of your bedroom, and every game starts at the usual pace unless you pick another (it's no longer remembered from last time)
